review_comments:
Please don't interact with integration details like hass.data in the tests. If we want to have the integration do another request of data we can move time forward with our test helper for that.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/c1b18f48678dd40a333ea05a588be1caf5b2a050/tests/common.py#L363-L366

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/development_testing#writing-tests-for-integrations
It would be better to create a method that does both sync calls and then schedule that method once on the executor. Switching context is expensive.
We don't need to check. Just iterate.
Side note: This doesn't need to be a coroutine function since we don't await inside.
